title: Understanding Silhouette Score
text: The silhouette score measures how similar a point is to its own cluster compared to other clusters. A negative silhouette score indicates that a point is closer to a neighboring cluster than to its own cluster.

title: Analyzing Clustering B
text: Look at the distribution of points in Clustering B. Are there any points that seem closer to a different cluster than their own?

title: Checking Point Proximity
text: In Clustering B, check if any point is closer to a different cluster than its own. If not, the silhouette score is not negative.
